user.title: Welcome to Nestor
user.description:
**Step 1 of 6.** Paste the license key from the email you got after subscribing, then select **Submit**.

No key yet? [Start a 7-day free trial]({trial_url}). Need help? [Setup guide]({help_url}).

data_description.license_key: Looks like XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. Copy it from the email exactly, without spaces.
data_description.cloud_url: Leave this as it is unless Nestor support asked you to change it.

name.title: Name your butler
name.description: **Step 2 of 6.** Pick a name or type your own. Your butler introduces itself with it, and you can say it when you talk to it.

personality.title: How should {name} talk?
personality.description: **Step 3 of 6.** You can change this any time just by asking, for example "be more casual".

language.title: Which language?
language.description: **Step 4 of 6.** With **Automatic**, Nestor answers in whatever language you speak to it — handy when family members speak different languages.

permissions.title: What may {name} do?
permissions.description:
**Step 5 of 6.** Tick what your butler may control or change. Anything not ticked stays read-only: it can still tell you about it, but can't change it.

⚠️ **Locks and alarm**: anyone who can talk to your butler could unlock doors or disarm the alarm. Only tick it if you're comfortable with that.

You can change this later in **Settings → Devices & services → Nestor → Configure**.

voice.title: Choose {name}'s voice
voice.description: **Step 6 of 6.** These are the voices installed in your Home Assistant. To listen to them before choosing, finish setup and open **Nestor** in the sidebar → ⚙︎ → Voice → ▶.

data_description.make_voice_assistant: Recommended. Your phone's Home Assistant app, watch and voice speakers will talk to Nestor. Your current settings for microphone and wake word are kept.
data_description.speak_replies: You can set quiet hours later by asking, for example "quiet hours from 10 PM to 7 AM".

error.invalid_key: That license key isn't valid. Copy it again from the email, without spaces.
error.subscription_inactive: This subscription isn't active. Renew it from the link in your receipt email, then try again.
error.too_many_instances: This key is already used on the maximum number of homes for its plan. Contact support to move it.
error.offline: Can't reach the Nestor service. Check this Home Assistant's internet connection and try again.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a minute.

abort.already_configured: Nestor is already set up. To change settings, go to Settings → Devices & services → Nestor → Configure.
